## Review checks

- [ ] Definition of Ready and applicable Definition of Done satisfied.
- [ ] Behavior changes to protected contracts received ADR/spec review BEFORE implementation.
- [ ] No language-specific workaround overrides shared contracts.
- [ ] Tests and required gates passed; planned tests are not reported as executed.
- [ ] No secrets/provider-specific domain identity; no AI privilege or hidden paid-budget escalation.
- [ ] Requirement trace and latest handoff point to actual evidence.
- [ ] Work stays within the authorized phase; P1 requires explicit P0 owner acceptance.
